title: Annihilation
author: Jeff VanderMeer
summary: An all-woman expedition crosses the border into Area X, a stretch of coast that has been sealed off from the world for decades. The biologist who narrates begins to realise that the place is changing her.
readIf: you like eerie, atmospheric weird fiction that leaves its biggest mysteries unexplained.
skipIf: you want clear answers or a conventional monster story, since the book deliberately does not give them.

pairings.reason: A classic about humans meeting something so alien that they cannot understand it.
Another unsettling book about a space that does not obey the rules, with a stranger structure.
A slower, domestic version of a place that quietly takes over those who enter.
